title_block.comment_1: CY7C1049G-10VXI 36-SOJ on the 32-SOJ site of U8..U11

findings.detail: J1: 30 signal pins per ground pin (recommended: ≤3 for EMI control)
findings.description: Connector J1 has 30.0 signal pins per ground pin.
findings.recommendation: Add more ground pins (target ≤3 signal pins per ground).

findings.description: ESD protection audit for generic connector J1: none coverage.
Net +5V carries power_in pins but has no power_out pin, no PWR_FLAG, no regulator output mapping, and no bridged solder jumper path to a sourced net.
findings.recommendation: Add a PWR_FLAG to declare the rail as externally powered (e.g. from a connector) or trace the rail back to a regulator output. If the source lives on another sheet, promote the net name to a global label.

report_context.impact: Rail has no source visible to the analyser; likely a wiring gap or missing PWR_FLAG.

findings.summary: JP1 (SolderJumper_2_Open) — open by default, between A17 ↔ E2
findings.recommendation: Open solder jumper is non-conducting until the pads are soldered. If either side is a power rail or required signal, the board won't function without the solder step.

findings.summary: JP2 (SolderJumper_2_Open) — open by default, between A18 ↔ HOST_PIN1
findings.recommendation: Open solder jumper is non-conducting until the pads are soldered. If either side is a power rail or required signal, the board won't function without the solder step.

text_annotations.text:
BMDC3 2 MB RAM interposer: CY7C1049G (512K x 8, 36-SOJ) on the 32-SOJ site of U8..U11.
Net names = host signal names. Address and data lines are permuted (see README table);
controls and power are not. A17/A18 come from 68030 A19/A20 by wire (TP1/TP2); JP1/JP2 stay open
unless the card is verified to drive A19/A20 on castellations 30/1. Firmware: patch_bmdc_ram.py --max 16M.

observations: +5V: highest SRF is 22.51 MHz — consider adding small (100pF-1nF) MLCC for >100 MHz coverage
Key nets without test points: 1 power_rail
